title: Victoria W
content: It was a normal day on November 16th. I worked as usual, and my youngest son was dropped off at his grandparents. Around 6:30, I went to pick my son up. It was dark out. I put my son in the car, and we drove the normal route I always take to get home. A few houses down was my mother's friend Lena’s house. I looked at her house and felt something dark coming from it. Then a voice in my head told me to call my mother and ask her if she thought her friend’s son would kill her. But I didn't, because I thought she would think I was nuts. I have had a previous similar experience that I once told her about, and she said nothing; I would just be ignored again. So I told myself I would go see her the next day, but I didn't. I got carried away with my own life. My mother called me two days later to tell me her friend’s son had killed her in her house. He then went to the hospital to kill his wife and afterward tried to kill himself. He was the only one who lived. I was in shock and filled with regret for a few months that I had done nothing. I still feel regret, but I am no longer in shock.

elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, In that moment, I knew what I was experiencing was real, but I also knew no one would believe me.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual, Time slowed down in that moment as a rush of thoughts came after.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My experience in that moment was worry and darkness.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: It just felt silent and dark.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: The time my cousin passed away, and her brother.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Muslim, I have always believed in God even before I became a Muslim. In rough times I would pray through the night just talking with God on my knees to heal me from my emotions. When the sun would rise I would feel like a new person with a fresh start. About three years ago I met my first husband and was introduced to Islam. This is the only religion I have ever reverted to, as somehow I knew man has tampered with the previous religions for their own goals.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, None
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, My mother has known about my previous experiences, but it was always after the situation happened. This time, I could have told her in advance, but I didn't. I told her about a week after what had happened to me. She never responded, as usual.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
